_readme: Colours for the world map. Edit a hex value, then run:  npm run map-style
That regenerates public/map/atlas-style.json, which the map reads.
upstreamStyle is the free basemap this is built on (no API key, no account).
If OpenFreeMap is ever unavailable, replace upstreamStyle with another
MapLibre style URL and run npm run map-style again.
